incident-bot: PagerDuty: high-frequency alert firing for service=router-cpu-heatmap (6 triggers in 3m). Incident ID: PD-98765. auto-resolve window 5m
Alex: acked. I'm on it. paging via PD, grabbing dashboards now :mag_right:
Sam: oncall here, ping me if you need escalations. any customer reports?
Alex: not seeing any 5xx spikes in prod logs, tailing router logs now. CPU spiky on a subset of pods. Looks like quick 10-20s bursts every ~30s.
Ryan: saw similar in canary earlier — KV warmup + micro-batching causing CPU churn. Could be harmless.
Alex: copying relevant metrics: cpu_percent spike on router-v2-*-pod: 85->95 for 15s, then back to 30. requests_latency p50 stable. no error increase.
Sam: good. can you run the quick runbook? runbook: /runbooks/router-spike (step 1: check autoscaler, step 2: pin model, step 3: escalate)
Alex: running autoscaler status...
Alex: ```
$ rctl autoscaler status router-v2
scales: active
recent_scale_events:
 - 2026-03-14T12:04:06Z scale_up delta=1 reason=burst
 - 2026-03-14T12:04:21Z scale_down delta=-1 reason=stabilize
```
Nora: PD note: there were duplicate PD pages getting created by a rule that hadn't deduped within 30s. PD auto-resolved duplicates after suppression window.
Alex: confirming — PD shows master incident opened then 5 dup pages auto-closed. The master remains acknowledged.
lisa-sre: pushed a quick tweak to metrics smoothing (moving average window from 10s->30s) in staging earlier; could be related if deployment rolled to prod. any deploys?
Alex: checking deploy history... no prod deploy in last 2h. staging tweak shouldn't have rolled.
Sam: can we check router pod restart counts?
Alex: pod restarts zero in last hour. logs show repeated KV cache coldfill logs at the same timestamps as the CPU blips. snippet: ```WARN kv: coldfill took=120ms keys=512 pod=router-v2-3```
Ryan: that'd align — coldfill triggers transient CPU for IO. autoscaler reacts but scales back quickly. PD rule firing on short blips is noisy.
Sam: since no customer impact, let's mark as noise and close with follow-up. Alex, create follow-up ticket to adjust PD rule and add cooldown. Assign infra.
Alex: will do. Also will add a short-lived suppression policy for future coldfill windows. Ticket: INFRA-4321 created. summary: reduce sensitivity on router-cpu alert, add 45s aggregation window, add runbook note about KV coldfill.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-98765 acknowledged by Alex at 2026-03-14T12:06:10Z
Nora: PD auto-resolved duplicate pages at 2026-03-14T12:07:05Z — no manual escalation required.
Sam: marking customer impact = none. adding :white_check_mark: to thread.
lisa-sre: follow-up action: test KV coldfill on staging with load profile and verify smoothing change. I'll take that and loop back.
Ryan: small ask — can we add a brief blurb to the alert text: "Transient KV coldfill spikes may occur; check runbook" to reduce cognitive load for oncall.
Alex: added note to INFRA-4321. putting incident into post-incident review bucket.
Sam: handing off monitoring to next oncall @Ryan in case noise recurs. Ryan, you're the responder for the next 4h.
Ryan: got it. I'll watch for repeats.
Alex: closing thread — PD master incident auto-resolved at 2026-03-14T12:11:18Z. No customer-facing impact.
incident-bot: Incident closed PD-98765 auto-resolved. Reaction summary: 1 ack, 0 escalations, 5 auto-closes.
Sam: nice. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
